ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Factory Logistics
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.8
Moving goods around a colony without hauling them by hand.
[Pneumatic tubes] A pneumatic tube network for moving goods around a colony quickly.
Lay compressed air tubes between rooms, put an air compressor and an air tank on them, and build tube senders and receivers where goods should go in and come out. Each sender is pointed at one receiver; a receiver can take from any number of senders.
Goods travel in capsules. A packing bench has ordinary bills: pick what to pack and how far to fetch it from, and set the bill to take its capsules to a tube sender, the same way a bill is told to take its product to a stockpile. The packer carries each capsule to the sender and it is fired down the tube. At the far end an unpack bill opens it, and the empty shell is kept to be used again.
Because they are real bills, "do until you have X" works: it counts the goods at the sender's destination and on their way there, so a bill can keep a kitchen or a workshop stocked and stop when it is.
A capsule carries a full stack, or up to 40 kg if that is less. Heavier capsules cost more air to fire: half the usual burst when nearly empty, one and a half times at the weight limit.
With "As above, So below" installed, tubes run between levels through its generated air risers, and capsules take the same time as on one level plus a little per level crossed.
The compressor idles while the air tanks are full and runs flat out to refill them after every capsule, so a busy network shows up on the power grid. If the compressor loses power or breaks down, the tubes stop until it is back.
[Conveyor arms] (with Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory) A conveyor arm works a VFE Factory belt line, and a button switches it between two jobs. As a Loader it stands with storage behind it and a conveyor in front, and puts goods onto the belt. As a Feeder it stands at the end of the belt, in front of a factory machine's input hopper, and puts what arrives into the machine.
Together they form a network: the Feeder reads what the machine's current process still needs, and every Loader on the belts leading to it sends exactly that - never more than is missing, counting what is already on its way. Belts can merge and run through underground conveyors. Anything that reaches the Feeder and is no longer wanted is set down beside it, so the line never jams.
A conveyor lift carries belt items to a partner lift, which puts them onto its own belt. With "As above, So below" a lift pairs by itself with the lift on the same spot a level up or down - a conveyor elevator - and arm networks follow belts between levels. Lifts can also be linked by hand over any distance. Without VFE Factory, this part simply does not load.
[Vehicle tube dock] (with Vehicle Framework) A pad on the tube network that vehicles park over. Loading, it is a tube receiver whose room is the parked vehicle's free cargo weight: what senders fire at it goes straight into the cargo, and anything sent while nothing is parked waits on the pad for the next vehicle. Unloading, it sends the vehicle's cargo out a capsule at a time to a receiver you choose, with a filter for what to take off. It never touches passengers or a vehicle being packed for a caravan. Works with every vehicle mod built on Vehicle Framework, such as Vanilla Vehicles Expanded.
Requires Vanilla Expanded Framework (the tubes are built on its pipe network). Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory, Vehicle Framework and As above, So below are optional.
